name: skillz
description: Codex skills for raising, monitoring, auditing, and merging GitHub pull requests.

interface.shortDescription: Raise, monitor, audit, and merge GitHub pull requests
interface.longDescription: A focused PR workflow for Codex: run the complete PR lifecycle automatically, or invoke separate skills to raise a pull request, monitor feedback and CI with permission-gated fixes, and merge only when every review and CI gate is clear.
defaultPrompt: Use $auto-pr to raise the current changes, monitor review and CI, and merge when every gate is clear.
Use $raise-pr to open a PR and start CodeRabbit review.
Use $babysit-pr to inspect PR feedback and CI.
Use $merge-pr to merge when all gates pass.
